design_vision.archetype: ARCHETYPE 6 (Vibrant Play) mixed with ARCHETYPE 1 (Organic & Earthy)
design_vision.mood: Warm, friendly, trustworthy, family-oriented, and playful but highly organized.
design_vision.core_concept: A digital school directory that retains the charm of a paper version (featuring a real children's drawing as the background) while offering fast filtering, robust search, and easy admin management.

typography.notes: We use Nunito globally for its rounded, friendly, and approachable letterforms which fit perfectly with a primary school context.

primary.description: Sky blue to convey trust, clarity, and friendliness.

secondary.description: Warm amber/yellow for playful accents and primary action highlights.

layout_and_spacing.global_container: max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 md:py-12

grid_system.classes_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8

surface_strategy.background: The app features a global background image (children's drawing). To ensure text legibility, the main wrapper must use a fixed background with `bg-cover bg-center bg-no-repeat bg-fixed`.
surface_strategy.glassmorphism_cards: All readable content blocks (directory cards, login panel, admin tables) MUST use high-opacity glassmorphism to contrast against the playful drawing background. Tailwind classes: `bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/50 shadow-soft`.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-primary-hover transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-white font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-secondary-hover transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-slate-600 font-bold rounded-full px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors

inputs_and_filters.text_input: w-full bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-full px-6 py-3 text-slate-800 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all font-medium
inputs_and_filters.dropdown: w-full bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-800 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/20

cards.class_card: flex flex-col bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/50 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-soft hover:shadow-hover transition-shadow
cards.student_row: flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center py-4 border-b border-slate-200/60 last:border-0 gap-2

badges.primary_contact: inline-flex items-center bg-primary-light text-primary-hover text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider

images.description: A colorful children's drawing to serve as the authentic 'Bottin scolaire' cover background. Admin can change this later.

icons.usage: Use rounded, friendly icons. Examples: `Search`, `Users`, `Phone`, `Mail`, `Star` (for primary contact), `Settings` (for admin).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (`-translate-y-1`) with an expanded shadow. Buttons subtly scale down on click (`active:scale-95`).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Smooth fade-in for directory lists to avoid jarring flashes when switching class filters.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Because the background is a complex image, the frosted white layer (`bg-white/90`) is mandatory behind any text.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup the global layout to use the provided Unsplash image as a fixed CSS background on the body or main wrapper.
2. Ensure Shadcn components (like Select, Dialog, Input) are heavily customized to use rounded corners (`rounded-2xl` or `rounded-full`) to match the kid-friendly aesthetic.
3. Build the 'Class Card' as a heavily padded, frosted glass container that lists the children inside that group.

4. For the Admin panel, use a cleaner, more standard dashboard approach (still maintaining the soft rounded corners and Nunito font) but perhaps with a solid white background for maximum data density and clarity when managing emails and Excel exports.
